aboutText: Data has become the foundation of decision-making in every field, from science and healthcare to industry and public services. CONFDSA brings together researchers, students and industry professionals on 4–5 November 2026 at Adana Alparslan Türkeş Science and Technology University to explore this transformation together.

Over two days, invited speakers from academia and industry will share their knowledge and experience across a wide range of topics, from the data science lifecycle and statistical modelling to machine learning, artificial intelligence applications and the tools data scientists use every day.
We look forward to welcoming you to a meeting built around knowledge sharing, new collaborations and inspiring discussions.

registration.intro: Registration for CONFDSA 2026 opens after the notification of acceptance. The steps and deadlines below will be updated as they are finalised.

sections.title: Who should register
sections.text: At least one author of each accepted abstract must register for the presentation to be included in the conference program. Participants who attend without presenting can also register as listeners.

sections.title: How to register
items: Check the fees on the Registration Fee page.
Fill in the registration form (the link will be published here).

accommodation.intro: Participants arrange their own accommodation. Adana offers a wide range of hotels in the city centre and close to the university.

sections.title: Getting to Adana
sections.text: Adana can be reached by air through Çukurova International Airport, and by intercity bus and train. The university is in the Sarıçam district, about 20 minutes from the city centre by car.
